new_drafts.title: Paper Lanterns (Drive)
new_drafts.harmony: F - Am - Bb - Bbm, one bar per chord
new_drafts.style: One bar of thin 8-bit pulse keyboard repeats a single pitch with silence. Round root-bass pulses and dry sampled big-beat drums enter in bar 2. Introduce a tiny two-note hook with thin reed-organ chords in bar 5. Instrumental bittersweet electronica, 133 BPM, 4/4 in F major, around 3:30. Target F - Am - Bb - Bbm, one bar per chord once harmony starts. Clear snare on beats 2 and 4, continuous eighth-note hats and a firm kick keep full-time forward motion. Tender sadness with a small warm lift; thin tones carry the feeling while drums carry the drive. Keep the two-note game-like hook and bass pattern plain and unchanged. Briefly thin the organ for four bars while hats and bass keep moving, then restore the same hook over wider organ chords and stronger drums. Add layers and force, never extra lead notes, ornaments, runs or counterlines.

new_drafts.title: After the Rain (Drive)
new_drafts.harmony: Gm - Cm - Eb - D, one bar per chord
new_drafts.style: Begin with a triangle-like digital keyboard repeating one pitch over light kick and steady eighth-note hats. Clear snare on beats 2 and 4 and plain sine-bass pulses enter in bar 3. In bar 5 introduce a tiny sorrowful two-note hook and warm percussive piano chord stabs. Instrumental driving electronica, 130 BPM, 4/4 in G minor, around 3:35. Target Gm - Cm - Eb - D, one bar per chord. Firm full-time big-beat drums push ahead while the fragile game-like lead stays tender. Keep its two pitches and simple rhythm unchanged; bass follows roots without runs. Piano supplies brief warm harmony, never another lead. A four-bar withdrawal reduces piano and kick weight while hats and bass continue, then the same hook returns with broader piano chords and stronger drums. Deeply wistful with an exhilarating pulse; grow force and width, never melodic detail.

new_drafts.title: Night Steps
new_drafts.harmony: Am - F - Dm - E, one bar per chord
new_drafts.style: Start with clean palm-muted guitar chord stabs and a firm breakbeat together. Plain triangle-sub root pulses enter in bar 2; a dry digital-mallet lead plays a tiny three-note game-like hook in bar 3. Instrumental hopeful electronica with a wistful undertone, 135 BPM, 4/4 in A minor, around 3:40. Target Am - F - Dm - E, one bar per chord. Clear snare on beats 2 and 4, continuous eighth-note hats and clipped kicks give full-time forward motion. Keep the lead to the same three pitches and plain rhythm throughout; guitar supplies chord rhythm, never a second melody. Warm 16-bit body grows around the simple digital voice without replacing it. A brief four-bar withdrawal keeps hats and bass moving, then the same hook returns with wider guitar harmony and stronger drums. Build hope through layers and chord color, never runs, arpeggios or counterlines.
